fields.summary_ko.0: Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL) is drawing investor attention by setting record highs even amid growth stock declines at the cycle's early stage, and has recently achieved double-digit earnings growth, accomplished in only 4 out of the past 16 years.
fields.summary_ko.1: With a trailing P/E of 40x and forward P/E of 38x, it is overvalued, but due to the new CEO's Needs Proof of Growth, bargain-buying opportunities are expected to be limited.
